description: Ross and Rachel adjust to raising Emma while Joey and Rachel's friendship turns romantic, Monica and Chandler confront infertility and begin considering adoption, and a trip to Barbados rearranges several relationships at once.

s09e01.description: Rachel believes Joey proposed after Emma's birth, leaving Ross hurt and Joey horrified as the misunderstanding spreads through the hospital.

s09e02.description: Ross and Rachel cannot stop Emma from crying and become increasingly exhausted, while Chandler falls asleep during an important meeting and accidentally agrees to relocate to Tulsa.

s09e03.description: Rachel becomes dependent on Ross's childhood pediatrician until the doctor's discomfort with adult patients becomes impossible to ignore, while Joey and Phoebe arrange blind dates.

s09e04.description: Monica misinterprets what she sees during a surprise visit to Chandler in Tulsa and tries to accommodate a bizarre fetish he does not actually have.

s09e05.description: Phoebe's birthday dinner degenerates as everyone arrives late or leaves early for competing crises, leaving her increasingly furious at the empty table.

s09e06.description: Ross is threatened by Rachel's sensitive male nanny despite the man's obvious competence, while Chandler worries Monica thinks another man is funnier than he is.

s09e07.description: Ross discovers an absurd song is the only thing that makes Emma laugh, while Phoebe meets Mike's wealthy parents and struggles through an uncomfortable dinner.

s09e08.description: Rachel's sister Amy visits and immediately clashes with everyone over her selfishness, especially after questioning who should care for Emma if something happens to Ross and Rachel.

s09e09.description: Rachel gives her number to a man at a bar and then fears Ross will answer when he calls, while Phoebe and Mike care for a litter of rats.

s09e10.description: Chandler spends Christmas working in Tulsa with an attractive colleague, forcing him to reconsider the job and finally choose being home with Monica.

s09e11.description: Rachel returns to Ralph Lauren early because she fears her temporary replacement is taking her job, leaving Ross to manage Emma and creating tension over Gavin.

s09e12.description: Phoebe reluctantly deals with the multiplying rats Mike has allowed her to keep, while Rachel and Gavin's workplace rivalry becomes increasingly personal.

s09e13.description: Monica performs karaoke and enjoys the crowd's enthusiasm until she realizes her shirt is revealing more than intended, while Ross and Rachel's dating lives become awkward.

s09e14.description: Joey and Phoebe secretly arrange terrible blind dates for Ross and Rachel, hoping each will realize they belong together.

s09e15.description: Phoebe recognizes the man who mugged Ross as someone from her own rough childhood, while Joey discovers his lack of stage experience may cost him an audition.

s09e16.description: Chandler mistakenly believes Monica wants breast implants and Monica thinks Chandler wants cosmetic surgery, while Rachel tries to babyproof the apartment.

s09e17.description: Ross and Chandler escalate an online prank by posting fake information about each other until Chandler announces Ross is dead and a memorial service actually attracts guests.

s09e18.description: The friends pool money for a huge lottery drawing, but arguments over tickets and Phoebe's intervention destroy their chances before the results arrive.

s09e19.description: Rachel begins developing feelings for Joey after watching him perform a romantic scene, while Chandler plans a romantic weekend with Monica that work keeps disrupting.

s09e20.description: Joey secretly hosts a party for soap-opera actors and tries to keep the others away, while Ross meets an attractive professor and Rachel's feelings for Joey grow.

s09e21.description: Monica and Chandler undergo fertility testing and receive difficult news, while Rachel becomes jealous when Joey dates another actress.

s09e22.description: Monica and Chandler consider asking a friend to be a sperm donor before learning adoption may be their best path, while Phoebe encounters an old flame.

s09e23-24.description: The group travels to Barbados for Ross's conference, where romantic loyalties shift as Joey and Charlie break up, Ross grows closer to Charlie and Rachel finally acts on her feelings for Joey.
